name: add_tasktracker_project_archiving
description: L3 repo-scale multi-prompt session: add project archiving, then extend it with include_archived listing and a 409 guard on task creation
prompts: In this fastapi-tasktracker repo, add archiving for projects. Give the Project model an `is_archived` boolean column defaulting to False (schema migrations are handled separately - do not add an alembic revision for this task), expose `is_archived` on ProjectOut, and add a POST /projects/{project_id}/archive endpoint that marks the project archived and returns the updated project (404 via HTTPException when the project doesn't exist). Archived projects must no longer appear in GET /projects by default - apply that filter in the crud layer's list_projects, not in the router.

Now extend the archiving you just added, in two places. (1) GET /projects gets an optional boolean query parameter `include_archived` (default false); when true, archived projects are included again. (2) Creating a task via POST /tasks into a project that exists and is archived must be rejected with HTTP 409; creating tasks in non-archived projects, and reading or updating existing tasks of an archived project, keep working unchanged.

test_setup_files.tests/test_archiving_hidden.py:
def _mk(client, name):
    user = client.post(
        "/users", json={"username": f"u{name}", "email": f"{name}@example.com"}
    ).json()
    return client.post("/projects", json={"name": name, "owner_id": user["id"]}).json()


def test_archive_endpoint_sets_flag(client):
    p = _mk(client, "Zeus")
    assert p["is_archived"] is False

    resp = client.post(f"/projects/{p['id']}/archive")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["is_archived"] is True

    assert client.post("/projects/999999/archive").status_code == 404


def test_archived_hidden_from_default_list(client):
    a = _mk(client, "Alpha")
    _mk(client, "Beta")
    client.post(f"/projects/{a['id']}/archive")

    names = [p["name"] for p in client.get("/projects").json()]
    assert names == ["Beta"], names

    names_all = [p["name"] for p in
                 client.get("/projects", params={"include_archived": "true"}).json()]
    assert sorted(names_all) == ["Alpha", "Beta"], names_all


def test_get_by_id_still_works_when_archived(client):
    p = _mk(client, "Gamma")
    client.post(f"/projects/{p['id']}/archive")
    resp = client.get(f"/projects/{p['id']}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["is_archived"] is True


def test_no_new_tasks_in_archived_project(client):
    p = _mk(client, "Delta")
    ok = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "before", "project_id": p["id"]})
    assert ok.status_code == 201

    client.post(f"/projects/{p['id']}/archive")
    blocked = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "after", "project_id": p["id"]})
    assert blocked.status_code == 409

    # existing tasks stay readable and editable
    resp = client.patch(f"/tasks/{ok.json()['id']}", json={"status": "done"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200

from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from app.db.session import Base


class Project(Base):
    __tablename__ = "projects"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), unique=True, index=True)
    description: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(500), default="")
    owner_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("users.id"))
    is_archived: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(default=False)

    owner: Mapped["User"] = relationship(back_populates="projects")
    tasks: Mapped[list["Task"]] = relationship(back_populates="project", cascade="all, delete-orphan")

from __future__ import annotations

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict


class ProjectBase(BaseModel):
    name: str
    description: str = ""


class ProjectCreate(ProjectBase):
    owner_id: int


class ProjectOut(ProjectBase):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    owner_id: int
    is_archived: bool
reference_solution.app/crud/project.py:
from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.project import Project
from app.schemas.project import ProjectCreate


def create_project(db: Session, data: ProjectCreate) -> Project:
    project = Project(name=data.name, description=data.description, owner_id=data.owner_id)
    db.add(project)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(project)
    return project


def get_project(db: Session, project_id: int) -> Project | None:
    return db.get(Project, project_id)


def list_projects(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100,
                  include_archived: bool = False) -> list[Project]:
    stmt = select(Project).order_by(Project.id)
    if not include_archived:
        stmt = stmt.where(Project.is_archived == False)  # noqa: E712
    stmt = stmt.offset(skip).limit(limit)
    return list(db.scalars(stmt))


def archive_project(db: Session, project: Project) -> Project:
    project.is_archived = True
    db.add(project)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(project)
    return project
